description_en: Returns all CA certificates for the user, including certificates generated internally by PCA and imported external certificates
description_zh: 返回用户所有CaCertificate，包括PCA内部产生的与导入的外部证书
name: DescribePcaAndExternalCACertificateList

parameters.help_en: The number of records to display per page. Default value: 50
parameters.help_zh: 指定每页显示多少条记录。默认值为50
parameters.name: show_size

parameters.help_en: The certificate identifiers. Separate multiple identifiers with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 证书标识。多个标识间英文逗号间隔
parameters.name: identifiers

parameters.help_en: The search keyword. Fuzzy search by name, domain name, or SANs is supported
parameters.help_zh: 查询关键字。支持通过名称、域名、SANS模糊查询
parameters.name: key_word
